title: Nutrition — the whole screen in frosted glass
question: The whole nutrition screen designed around the tubes you chose, so nothing old sits around them. Two compositions. Pick one to build, or steer.

options.label: Everything on one screen
options.thesis: Header with the day and arrows, History / Today / Recipes / Profile, the tubes card, what is left today, water, and the meals.
options.viewport: Every part the screen has today, all in glass.
options.risk: Dense: seven blocks on one screen.

options.label: Airy, the tubes lead
options.thesis: A large 'Today', the tubes big and standing free on the light, water as one pill, meals with 'Add a meal'.
options.risk: History / Recipes / Profile and 'left today' need a new home (the calendar button, or inside the tubes).
